ef6aab18.text:
Kegan Darkmar, leader of the small group of undead who came to us in search of asylum from their "brethren," defies our common attitudes toward his kind.  His skin may be rotting and blood may have long stopped flowing through his veins, but he acts very nobly and seems to care more for his compatriots' safety than his own.

Indeed, there is a humanity within him that, I confess, I sometimes see lacking in the humans around me.
ef6aab18.title: Belamoore's Research Journal

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12137|c087faab.name: Squibby Overspeck
12137|c087faab.text: Slip a little coin into the boss's hand and look what it gets ya. I love my job. Though, if I could find a way to get that little firecracker Snurk reassigned to this port....well, I can't imagine it any better. But I'm betting that you aren't here about my business practices. You're looking for the Zeppelin to Undercity, am I right? Well that's great, because it docks right here behind me. Oh and hey, if you see Snurk, put a good word in for me, would ya?

12736|e3f9a765.name: Je'neu Sancrea
12736|e3f9a765.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

1385|324e1b75.name: Brawn
1385|324e1b75.text: We have only a small foothold on this continent for now, but the humans can't fight us off forever. Then they'll pay for enslaving us. We'll cut their lying tongues out for their treachery.

1387|c5ceacbe.name: Thysta
1387|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3149|ae6d6ab0.name: Nez'raz
3149|ae6d6ab0.text: Why you would want to leave these sunny shores and crystal blue waters I have no idea. It's like paradise down here. But don't tell my brother Zapetta that, he's bitter enough already about getting stuck up there in Tirisfal all day long. This Zeppelin here drops off at Orgrimmar so you shouldn't have to worry about having to listen to him whine. But if you are in Tirisfal anytime soon, heed my warning and don't get him started.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3318|2f8d506f.name: Koma
3318|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3318|6b36598f.name: Koma
3318|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3318|ae78a458.name: Koma
3318|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3344|1605f087.name: Kardris Dreamseeker
3344|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

5814|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Thulbek
5814|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

1431-accept.name: Craven Drok
1431-accept.text:
Be still, $c, and allow me to share with you something important to our people, but far from obvious.

We are a proud race, and the war with the humans tried even Thrall's great patience. You see, our Warchief is wise and prudent, and he continues to put his people first. Ultimately, he is a diplomat, and in his time with the humans he learned much of their ways.

If the tale I've started piques your interest, then find Keldran near the western exit of the city. His hovel is there.
1431-accept.title: Alliance Relations

556-progress.name: Keeper Bel'varil
556-progress.text: Do you have the Worn Stone Tokens, $N?  The Magus is eager to unlock their secrets.
556-progress.title: Stone Tokens

6565-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-complete.text:
Very good!! Thank you, $N. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.

Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
6565-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

98887-complete.name: Horde Warbringer
98887-complete.text:
The sands of the Darkspear Islands are awash with the blood of the Alliance you've killed. Well done, $N.

For the Horde!
98887-complete.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98887-progress.name: Horde Warbringer
98887-progress.text: What news from the Darkspear Islands, $N?
98887-progress.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98888-progress.name: Horde Warbringer
98888-progress.text: The fight in Darkspear Islands is ceaseless, $N. Together, we will destroy the Alliance dogs in the Theramore Expeditionary Force!
98888-progress.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98906-complete.name: Nizook Boof
98906-complete.text: You be showin' strength and dedication out at the Darkspear Islands! Your prowess in battle are to be admired, mon!
98906-complete.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!
